name: coreai-zoo-skills
description: Skills for reproducing, verifying, and porting models in the Core AI model zoo — community ports of open models to Apple's Core AI runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Reproduce, verify, and port on-device models for Apple's Core AI runtime
interface.longDescription: The Core AI model zoo publishes community ports of open models as .aimodel bundles, each with the recipe that produced it. These skills cover choosing a model from the catalog, reproducing a published bundle with one command and its prerequisites, verifying that a bundle agrees with the model it came from, and porting a new model with the zoo's oracle-first gating method.
